title: daphne micrantha subsp. longipaniculata
intro: Daphne micrantha subsp. longipaniculata, commonly known as the Small-leaved Daphne, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Thymelaeaceae. It is a shrub-like plant known for its small, fragrant flowers and is traditionally used in various forms of folk medicine. The plant is believed to offer several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe respiratory issues, reduce fever, and alleviate skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Daphne micrantha subsp. longipaniculata include daphnetin, daphnodorin, and other flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and anti-cancer properties.
